stories.title: Game 3 Recap — Bullpen Blows 10th-Inning Lead
stories.angle: PCA gave the Cubs the lead in the 10th with a 2-run HR; Trent Thornton couldn't hold it; Herrera's double walked off the Cardinals. Cubs still lead series 2-1. NO score in tweet — insights override.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
PCA gave the Cubs the lead with a 2-run HR in the 10th.

The bullpen gave it right back.

Iván Herrera's double off Trent Thornton ended it for St. Louis. Cubs still lead the series 2-1 — but this one stings.

stories.title: Trade Deadline — Passan Drops Skubal Bomb, Cubs in the Room
stories.angle: Jeff Passan told SportsCenter Wednesday night the Tigers are trading Tarik Skubal — two-time AL Cy Young winner. Cubs are "considering" per The Athletic's Patrick Mooney. Dodgers and Brewers are frontrunners. Hoyer has 4 days and willing to move "majority" of prospects. The biggest deadline story yet.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Jeff Passan just said it on SportsCenter: the Tigers are trading Tarik Skubal.

Two-time AL Cy Young. Cubs are reportedly in the room.

Four days left. Hoyer, it's time to level up.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: PCA — MVP Odds Jump to +185 as Ohtani's Knee Enters the Picture
stories.angle: PCA MVP odds went from +3000 to +185 in three weeks. His last 55 games: 211 wRC+, 1.161 OPS, 5.7 fWAR. Shohei Ohtani's knee is limiting his pitching, narrowing his case. The race is genuinely on.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Three weeks ago, Pete Crow-Armstrong was +3000 to win NL MVP.

He's now +185.

A 211 wRC+, 1.161 OPS, and 5.7 fWAR over his last 55 games will do that.

Shohei Ohtani's knee is limiting his pitching. The race is genuinely on.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Cardinals 54-54, 9-13 in July, Playing Spoiler Badly
stories.angle: Cardinals won Game 3 last night — their first win of the series. They're still 54-54, 9-13 in July, and 15th in the NL wild card standings. The Cardinals calling this a "statement win" is the funniest story in baseball.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Cardinals won a game last night. Good for them.

They're still 54-54 in late July, 9-13 this month, and 15th in the NL wild card standings.

St. Louis fans calling this a "statement win" is my favorite content of the summer.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Game 4 Preview — Assad vs Pallante, 1:15 PM CT Series Finale
stories.angle: Javier Assad (6-1, 3.86 ERA, 1.12 WHIP) takes the ball for the series finale at Busch. Faces Andre Pallante (11-6, 3.77 ERA). Cubs lead series 2-1, close it out today. Assad is the unsung anchor of this patchwork rotation.

stories.title: Brewers Are Frontrunners for Skubal — Cubs' Two-Front War
stories.angle: Passan calls Brewers among the frontrunners for Skubal — they have the prospect capital. They're already 6.5 games up in the NL Central. If Milwaukee lands Skubal, the Cubs lose their top target AND the division gap widens. Hoyer is fighting a two-front war with 4 days left.
